<p class="skill-reference-meta"><span>Included since Arcantry 0.3.0</span><code>$evaluate-skill-change</code></p>

Compare a baseline and candidate Codex skill on synthetic routing and behavior cases before adoption. Use only when explicitly invoked with $evaluate-skill-change; do not edit or install the live skill and never auto-adopt a candidate.

## Link this skill

```text
arcantry skills link evaluate-skill-change
```

## Examples

### Gate a proposed skill rewrite

**Prompt**

> Use $evaluate-skill-change with this baseline, candidate, and case file. Tell me whether the candidate should be adopted.

**Expected outcome**

An accept, reject, or needs-review decision based on identical cases, held-out coverage, validation, and regressions.

### Check a trigger change

**Prompt**

> Use $evaluate-skill-change to compare these skill descriptions for routing precision without installing either candidate.

**Expected outcome**

Comparable routing and behavior evidence with the live skill left untouched and no automatic adoption.
